en-US:
• Check in and out of places from Apple Watch, even offline. Each check-in keeps the time you tapped and reaches your iPhone when the Watch reconnects.
• Apple Watch recording is more reliable: it retries after a cold launch, starts once you allow location later, and delivers long routes in full.
• Timeline updates as soon as you edit a visit, and a recording that runs past midnight now stays within each day's route and totals.
• The map's day sheet now follows your finger when you drag it.
